hero.description: Xalor is a build-time TypeScript engine that turns your native types into a live runtime validation and generation system — without duplicating schemas or shipping heavy libraries.

options.title: Register
Validation

whatIsXalor.description: Xalor shifts heavy type parsing from the browser to your build toolchain. It compiles native types into lightweight blueprints, eliminating runtime overhead.
whatIsXalor.subDescription: Instead of reconstructing types at runtime, Xalor executes against precompiled structures created during the build process.

stepOne.label: Write Native Types
stepOne.description: No custom schemas or validation languages to learn.

stepTwo.label: Build-Time Compilation
stepTwo.description: Xalor turns your types into lightweight runtime blueprints.

stepThree.label: Runtime Power
stepThree.description: Validate, mock, and transform data at hardware speeds.

stepFour.label: Execute at Runtime
stepFour.description: Validate, generate, and transform data directly from precompiled blueprints.

runtimeModule.description: Stop maintaining separate verification engines and mock data setups. Xalor converts native types into high-speed runtime systems with zero bundle inflation.

validate.description: Ensure raw inbound payloads match your compile-time types with deep error reporting and zero runtime schema overhead.
validate.subDescription: Catch structural failures instantly at your system boundaries.

generate.description: Stamp out completely populated testing fixtures, safe default fallbacks, and mock shapes derived directly from native type graphs.
generate.subDescription: Instant mockup datasets generated without maintaining fixture files.

transform.description: Pick, omit, sanitize, and reshape messy structures using type-aware utilities running on hardware-level lookup paths.
transform.subDescription: Peel away unsafe variables without redefining your schemas.

match.description: Eliminate the dual-source tax entirely. Write standard TypeScript contracts once and execute them natively anywhere across your stack.
match.subDescription: Absolute architectural sync across edge paths and user frontends.

docsCta.header: Ready to see it in action?
docsCta.description: The fastest way to understand the performance power of Xalor is to experience it yourself. Explore our preloaded testing layouts or spin up your own configuration environment.

earlyPreviewNote.description: Xalor is currently in active development.This preview is intended to explore the core ideas behind the project and gather feedback while the runtime engine and tooling continue to evolve.APIs and behaviors may change before a stable release.
